GENERATED by tools/skills/emit_abilities.py from design/data-drafts/skills-v2/*.json - edit the drafts (or tools/skills/skill_tables.py) and re-run; do not hand-edit. GENERATED (2026-10-24 v2 build; first built 2026-10-22): every affinity's v2 skills, rebuilt around its role; dropped skills are gone. Keys from the drafts: ascension_fields (aspect -> the field an ascension boost acts on), role_fit (role | utility), parent_trait (a hybrid skill's parent). New keys: base_rune and signature (the rune the skill is built on, and the fields its nature lives in); starter; draft_kind where the draft named a kind the game builds as another (hex, smite, seize and gaze are kind 'smite': an instant effect on the targeted enemy); magnitude (self buffs and channels: the fields a rune's power op scales, as an amount or as a multiplier's gap from 1); simplified (what the game does not build yet; the summary says '(simplified)'); good_modifiers (the draft's). New kinds: smite, channel (held: cost is per second, a payload every 'tick' along 'shape' line | cone | nearest | tether | self), charge_release (hold up to charge_max, release as 'release'), summon (a thrall from a corpse), seed (hidden, triggered), grapple (moved to a point), streak (through bodies in one step), field_pulse (acts on your corpses or growth). A hit payload may also carry: status_s (how long its status lasts), status_data, consume, consume_stacks, bonus_flat_vs, poise_vs, through (ignores front block and shields), jumps (arcs on to more enemies), execute_below, unliving_mult, stun_per_mark, turn_s, needs_facing, release_shove, hard_interrupt, interrupts_moving.

tsunami_strike.name: Breaker
tsunami_strike.summary: A wide, heavy blow (2.4x strike damage, 30 poise) that throws everyone it hits 4 m away from you. Stand so the wall is behind them.

cataract.name: Cataract
cataract.summary: Hold to gather the weight of falling water over your fists (up to 1.2 s; you are Braced and walk at 30%), then bring it down: everything within 3 m takes 1.4x to 3.0x strike damage by the charge, is Soaked, loses 60 poise and is thrown 3 m outward. One already against a wall or stone takes half again and is Crushed where it stands.

riptide_lash.name: Riptide Lash
riptide_lash.verse: A rope of water for one throat.
riptide_lash.summary: One enemy within 10 m is hauled to arm's length, takes 60, is Soaked and interrupted - and arrives with its back to you for a second. Water's ranged starter: the bruiser does not shoot the runner, it hauls it in.

standing_pool.name: Standing Pool
standing_pool.verse: A tide that forgot to leave.
standing_pool.summary: Point, 9 m: a pool 3.5 m across for 8 s. Enemies in it are Soaked and 30% slower, and a shove that starts in it goes twice as far. No damage.

drawdown.name: Drawdown
drawdown.simplified: it does not empty your Standing Pool toward you
drawdown.summary: Every Soaked enemy within 8 m has the water torn out of it toward you: its Soak ends and it is dragged 3 m toward you. You get 2 essence back for each. Your Standing Pool in range empties toward you too, dragging those in it twice as far, and is gone. (simplified)

drench.name: Drench
drench.summary: Point, 10 m: a cloudburst gathers for 0.6 s, then falls on a 3 m circle. Everyone under it is Waterlogged for 6 s and interrupted. A Waterlogged heavy enemy is shoved as if it were light, and an elite as if it were heavy.

wringing_grip.name: Wringing Grip
wringing_grip.summary: One enemy within reach: you grip it and wring the water out. A 2.0x blow, +100 if it was Soaked (+200 if Waterlogged) - the grip uses the Soak up - and it reels back 1 m. Little more than a hard slap on a dry target.

overboard.name: Overboard
overboard.summary: Grab one enemy within reach, lift it on a column of water and hurl it up to 6 m toward where you aim (heavy ones half as far; an elite only staggers). 40 when you grab it; where it lands, everyone within 1.5 m takes 40 and is knocked aside. Thrown into a wall, stone or another body, it is Crushed.

drowning_hold.name: Drowning Hold
drowning_hold.summary: One enemy within 8 m: a ball of water closes over its head for 3 s. It is interrupted, cannot attack, cast, drum or call for help, and takes 20 at once and 15 a second. When the water lets go it heaves the enemy 3 m away from you, so put the wall behind it first.

backwash.name: Backwash
backwash.verse: Let it hit the water instead.
backwash.summary: 6 s or three blows, whichever ends first: each melee hit on you is halved, and the water splashes off you - whoever threw the blow, and everyone else within 2 m of you, is shoved 3 m and Soaked.

seepage.name: Seepage
seepage.summary: One enemy within 9 m: water soaks in under its guard for 0.6 s, then wells up behind it - 50 damage that ignores its shield and armour, and a 1.5 m tug toward you. For 4 s its shield and armour count for nothing, against anyone.

hydraulic_flex.name: Sluice Step
hydraulic_flex.summary: You roll forward about 6.5 m as a wave. Every enemy you meet takes 30, is Soaked and is carried 3 m on ahead of you, the way you are going; one carried into a wall, stone or another body is Crushed.

siltfall.name: Siltfall
siltfall.summary: Everything you moved settles. Every enemy within 10 m that a water skill shoved or dragged in the last 1.5 s hits the floor where it now stands: 40 damage, Pinned (60% slower) for 2 s and 30 poise. Bodies still sliding finish their slide first.

cinder_spit.name: Cinder Spit
cinder_spit.verse: A coal from the mouth. It was never going to stay in.
cinder_spit.summary: A quick, cheap bolt that sets its target Alight. Weak cold; it is how you get hot.

kiln_fist.name: Kiln Fist
kiln_fist.verse: Fire the hand like clay. Then find out what it breaks.
kiln_fist.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Alight, interrupts. If it was already burning, every stack is spent for +45 and the blow bursts, setting 2 Alight on everything within 2.5 m.

flashover.name: Flashover
flashover.verse: The room does not burn slowly. Neither do you.
flashover.summary: A short dash that leaves a line of flame for 3 s: anything standing in it takes 12 and catches. It does not carry you through enemies.

pyre_call.name: Pyre Call
pyre_call.summary: A short breath in, then every Alight enemy within 10 m loses its stacks, and each stack bursts for 45 in 2 m. Spread the burns first; call them once.

backdraft.name: Backdraft
backdraft.summary: Open the door. First every enemy within 5 m is drawn 2 m toward you, then the blast: they take 4 x the heat you carry above 20, and your fire reflux drops to 20. 320 at full heat; nothing when cold.

bellows_breath.name: Bellows Breath
bellows_breath.summary: Hold: a cone of fire 5 m long and 60 degrees wide. 50 damage a second and 1 Alight every half second to everything in it. You walk at 45% while holding. 6 essence a second, and every second of it heats you - the fastest way to get hot.

stoke.name: Stoke
stoke.verse: Feed it. It was going to eat anyway.
stoke.summary: At once, +25 heat, and a gust of it: everything within 2.5 m takes 20 and catches. For 6 s every bare strike you land sets its target Alight.

slag_pool.name: Slag Pool
slag_pool.verse: The floor remembers being a furnace.
slag_pool.summary: Lobbed to a point, 9 m: 3 m across for 6 s. 25 a second and 1 Alight a second to enemies standing in it.

hiss.name: Hiss
hiss.summary: One burning enemy within 9 m: every Alight stack on it goes out at once and it takes 50 per stack, all now. Your fire reflux drops 6 per stack. Five stacks: 250 damage and 30 heat off.

wickpinch.name: Wickpinch
wickpinch.summary: Costs no essence: it burns 15 of your heat instead, and cannot be cast below 15. One enemy within 7 m has its flame pinched out: whatever it was doing is interrupted - even an attack not marked interruptible - and it loses 40 poise. A Censer-Bearer snuffed this way no longer bursts when it dies.

flashpan.name: Flashpan
flashpan.summary: A flash of flame from your hands across a 90-degree cone 6 m deep. 30 damage, and everyone in it that is facing you is Blinded for 1 s plus 1 s for every 30 heat you carry (up to 4 s). Archers lose their aim.

smokepall.name: Smokepall
smokepall.summary: Lobbed to a point, 9 m: a pall of smoke 3 m across. Enemies in it are Slowed, ranged enemies cannot see into or through it, and burns inside neither run down nor go easy: Alight on them ticks 25% harder. Lasts 4 s, plus 1 s for every 20 heat you carry (up to 9 s).

white_heat.name: White Heat
white_heat.summary: Dear and slow: a 0.6 s wind-up, then one enemy within 14 m is struck by a point of white heat: 150 damage and 60 poise, and your Heat bonus counts twice on it. Cold it is a good hit; at full heat it is the biggest single blow fire has.

brushfire.name: Brushfire
brushfire.summary: One burning enemy within 10 m: its fire leaps to everything within 4 m of it. Each takes 30 and as many Alight stacks as the target carries, up to 3. Light one well, then let it catch.

slingstone.name: Slingstone
slingstone.verse: A stone has all the time there is. Lend it yours.
slingstone.summary: A slow, heavy stone thrown Braced: 70 damage, 45 poise, it stops what it hits mid-swing, and it Taunts it for 4 s - it drops what it was doing and comes for you. Thrown into your own stone, it shatters it.

landslide_blow.name: Landslide Blow
landslide_blow.verse: The hill does not swing. It simply stops holding on.
landslide_blow.summary: A broad, slow, crushing blow across 100 degrees, Braced: 2x strike damage and 60 poise to everything in it, and each one is Taunted for 4 s. It moves nobody, and shatters every stone of yours in its arc.

bedrock_shove.name: Bedrock Shove
bedrock_shove.verse: Put your shoulder where the mountain keeps its own.
bedrock_shove.summary: Shoulder first, 3.5 m, Braced throughout. The first enemy you meet is thrown 2 m and loses 50 poise (a heavy one stops you dead and loses 60), and everything within 3 m of where you stop is Taunted for 4 s.

raise_slab.name: Raise Slab
raise_slab.verse: Ask the floor to stand up. It remembers how.
raise_slab.summary: A wall of stone across your aim, up to 8 m away. It blocks movement and shots - theirs and yours - for 12 s. Three at a time.

pillar.name: Pillar
pillar.verse: The ground has an opinion about where they are standing.
pillar.summary: Point, 9 m: a circle is marked for half a second, then a column punches up - 90, 60 poise, interrupts - and stays as stone.

sinkhole.name: Sinkhole
sinkhole.simplified: a mire zone, not a pit: enemies are not trapped, do not path round it, and it is not one of your stones
sinkhole.summary: Point, 9 m, 0.5 s wind-up (Braced): the floor drops into a pit 2.5 m across for 10 s. Enemies standing there fall in for 30 damage and 40 poise. Inside they are Mired and need 1.5 s to climb out; enemies walk round it, and shots fly over it. It counts as one of your three stones. (simplified)

stonehide.name: Stonehide
stonehide.verse: Decide to be somewhere, and be there.
stonehide.summary: 8 s Braced: 40% less damage, and nothing staggers or shoves you. You move 25% slower, and the ground within 2.5 m of you thickens: enemies in it are Mired.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.verse: Everything standing is standing on your say-so.
tremor.summary: Everything within 5 m takes 50, is interrupted and Slowed for 3 s - and every stone you have standing shatters outward at once.

cave_in.name: Cave-In
cave_in.simplified: the rubble is a stone block: it also stops shots
cave_in.summary: Point, 10 m, 0.4 s wind-up (Braced): rock comes down on a 3 m circle a full second later. Everything still under it takes 100 and 70 poise and is Stunned for 1 s, elites included. The rubble stays for 15 s: nothing can walk through it, but shots pass over. It counts as one of your three stones. (simplified)

millstone.name: Millstone
millstone.summary: For 6 s you are as heavy as the hill: nothing moves, staggers or throws you, and you walk at 60%. Every enemy within 6 m is drawn toward you, 1 m a second, and Taunted while it stays inside. When it ends the ground settles under you: everything within 3 m takes 60 and 40 poise.

quarry_throw.name: Quarry Throw
quarry_throw.simplified: the rubble left behind does not slow anyone
quarry_throw.summary: Hold to tear a boulder out of the floor (rooted and Braced, up to 1.5 s), release to lob it at the cursor, up to 14 m. 110 to 280 damage in 2.5 m by how long you held, 80 poise, and it leaves rubble: a stone that also slows enemies within 2 m of it by 40%. (simplified)

cairn.name: Cairn
cairn.simplified: the target is held and takes a quarter of hits instead of the cairn taking them; breaking it does nothing extra
cairn.summary: One enemy within 8 m, 0.4 s wind-up (Braced): earth heaps over it. It is Buried for 2.5 s - it cannot move or act, and blows land on the stone, not on it. Shatter the cairn and the one inside takes 120 and is Staggered. Elites are Pinned instead. The cairn counts as one of your three stones. (simplified)

burrow.name: Burrow
burrow.simplified: it passes through bodies but not under stone or shots
burrow.summary: 0.3 s wind-up (Braced), then you go under the floor and come up 6 m on, 0.4 s later, passing beneath enemies, stone and shots. Where you surface the ground heaves: enemies within 1.5 m lose 40 poise and are pushed 1.5 m off. (simplified)

cutting_gust.name: Cutting Gust
cutting_gust.verse: Air has an edge. Most people never find it.
cutting_gust.summary: A short gust that passes through everything in its line. Spends up to 3 pips for +15 each - weak from a standstill.

crosscut.name: Crosscut
crosscut.verse: Do not meet them. Pass through where they were looking.
crosscut.summary: One enemy within 7 m: you cut through and stop behind it. Always a hit from behind. Spends every pip for +10% each.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.verse: Something behind you agrees you should leave.
tailwind.summary: The longest dash, +3 pips, and the only one with no recovery: you can strike or cast the instant it ends.

veil.name: Crosswind Veil
veil.verse: Nothing thrown at you arrives where you are.
veil.summary: 5 s: enemy shots that would pass within 1.5 m of you curve away and miss, each one turned gives you a pip, and your Slipstream does not drain. Blades still land.

gale_lane.name: Gale Lane
gale_lane.verse: A road only you can run.
gale_lane.summary: A lane 10 m long from your feet, 6 s. In it you move 40% faster and gain pips twice as fast; enemies are pushed down it.

spindrift.name: Spindrift
spindrift.summary: Hold while you run: you keep full speed, and every 0.25 s the nearest enemy within 3 m takes 25 (with Lee if you are behind it). Costs 6 essence a second and 1 pip every half second; ends when the pips run out.

downdraft.name: Downdraft
downdraft.summary: You spring up and come down on a point up to 7 m away, over bodies and gaps. Everything within 3 m of where you land takes 60, is interrupted and Pinned for 2 s; anything Aloft takes 100 more. Spends up to 3 pips for +15 each.

turning_palm.name: Turning Palm
turning_palm.summary: A 0.6 s stance. The first blow, charge or pounce aimed at you from within 3 m misses: you slip behind the attacker and strike it for 1.8x strike damage from behind, it is left Turned for 1.5 s, and you gain 2 pips. If nothing comes, half the essence comes back.

updraft.name: Updraft
updraft.verse: What goes up is yours until it comes down.
updraft.summary: Point, 8 m: enemies within 2.5 m are thrown Aloft for 1.2 s (+0.2 s a pip, up to 4) - helpless, and taking 25% more. Heavy ones lose poise instead.

dead_air.name: Dead Air
dead_air.summary: Spend every pip: a 4 m bubble of still air where you stand, lasting 1 s plus 1 s per pip spent. Enemy shots that enter it drop to the floor, your pips do not drain, and your wind reflux sheds while you stand in it. Step out and it ends.

dust_devil.name: Dust Devil
dust_devil.summary: Point, 9 m: a whirlwind 3 m across that drags enemies toward its middle and cuts them for 15 every half second. It drifts at walking pace the way you were running when you cast it, taking them along. Lasts 1.5 s, plus 1 s per pip spent (up to 4).

blowout.name: Blowout
blowout.summary: Everything within 4.5 m is blown apart: 30 damage and thrown 2 m outward, and each one lands Turned for 1 s, its back to you. Spends up to 4 pips: +0.5 m and +10 damage each. It also blows smoke and gas away and knocks shots in flight out of the ring.

arc_lash.name: Arc Lash
arc_lash.verse: It was there and now it is here.
arc_lash.summary: Instant and short: it cannot miss what it points at. 85 damage and a Live mark, then it arcs to one more enemy within 4 m for the same. Walls stop it.

thunderclap_palm.name: Thunderclap Palm
thunderclap_palm.verse: The sound arrives after the damage, to apologise.
thunderclap_palm.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Live marks, and it stops whatever it was doing. The crack Dazes and staggers everyone within 2.5 m of it, the target too.

stepped_leader.name: Stepped Leader
stepped_leader.verse: Find the path first. Then take all of it at once.
stepped_leader.summary: You are simply there, up to 6 m away: over enemies and gaps, not through walls or stone. Everything beside where you land takes 30 and a Live mark, and you are Quickened for 2 s after.

static_coat.name: Static Coat
static_coat.verse: Touch me and learn what I am carrying.
static_coat.summary: 6 s: every bare strike you land adds a Live mark and sparks on to the nearest other enemy within 3 m, marking it too; an enemy that hits you in melee takes 25 and a mark.

stored_bolt.name: Stored Bolt
stored_bolt.summary: Hold up to 1.2 s, walking slowly; let go and you are the bolt: you cross 4 m at a tap, 8 m at a full hold, through everything in the way. Each body you pass takes 80 to 220 and 1 to 3 Live marks by how long you held. A full charge Overloads the whole line.

dead_short.name: Dead Short
dead_short.verse: Everything you have marked, all at once, for less.
dead_short.summary: Every marked enemy within 12 m Overloads now: 40% of the full blow and stun at 1 mark, 70% at 2, all of it at 3. It grounds no reflux.

forked_path.name: Forked Path
forked_path.verse: It does not choose. It takes every road.
forked_path.summary: One enemy within 9 m, then up to three more within 5 m of each other: you flash from one to the next, striking each from behind for 1.2x strike damage and a Live mark, and stop behind the last. Never the same body twice.

seize_up.name: Seize Up
seize_up.summary: Everything within 3 m locks up: 30 damage, and Stunned for 0.4 s for every Live mark it carries (0.2 s if none). It spends no marks.

plumb_bolt.name: Plumb Bolt
plumb_bolt.summary: One enemy within 14 m is struck from straight above: 100 damage, 30 poise and a Live mark. Bodies, shields and low walls between you do not stop it.

ground_rod.name: Ground Rod
ground_rod.verse: Give the sky a second place to land.
ground_rod.summary: Point, 8 m: a rod for 10 s that blocks nothing. Each lightning skill you cast within 8 m of it also arcs from the rod to the nearest enemy within 5 m: 40 and a mark. One rod at a time.

bell_jar.name: Bell Jar
bell_jar.simplified: Overload arcs are not kept inside the jar
bell_jar.summary: One enemy within 12 m is sealed under a jar of still air for 6 s: 30 damage and a Live mark. Nothing passes in or out of it: no auras, no death burst, no arcs. Overload it and the whole arc stays inside: +60 for every other marked enemy within 12 m. (simplified)

dead_line.name: Dead Line
dead_line.summary: Point, 9 m: a ring 3 m across hums for 6 s. Enemies inside cannot cast, drum or call for help. Each takes 20, a Live mark and an interrupt once, on entering.

set_solid.name: Set Solid
set_solid.summary: The air around you sets. Everything within 3.5 m takes 30 damage and 3 Chill: two more and it freezes solid.

false_spring.name: False Spring
false_spring.simplified: a thawed body does not keep the two Chill that Frozen leaves
false_spring.summary: Every Frozen enemy within 10 m thaws at once, and the cold it held pours out: 50 damage and 3 Chill to every other enemy within 3 m of it. It frees what you froze, to freeze the ones beside it. (simplified)

hoarline.name: Hoarline
hoarline.summary: A line of frost races 10 m along the ground: 45 damage and 2 Chill to everything on it. The line stays frosted for 4 s, adding a Chill a second to anyone standing on it. Walls stop it.

black_ice.name: Black Ice
black_ice.summary: Lay a strip of glaze 6 m ahead and slide the length of it. The glaze stays 5 s: you move 30% faster on it; enemies on it keep slipping, losing poise every half second, and a shove that starts on it goes twice as far.

whiteout.name: Whiteout
whiteout.summary: Point, 10 m: snow falls over a circle 3.5 m across for 6 s. Enemies inside cannot see past 2 m (Blinded) and gain a Chill every second. Archers inside lose you.

runoff.name: Runoff
runoff.summary: An instant line 8 m long melts the cold out of everything on it: 25 damage plus 30 for every Chill it carried, and the Chill is gone. A Frozen one counts as 5 and is freed. All of them are left Soaked.

rime_wall.name: Rime Wall
rime_wall.summary: Point, 10 m: a wall of rime 5 m long rises across your aim in a quarter second and stands 6 s. It blocks walking and every shot, as standing stone does. Anyone it rises under is shoved 1 m clear and gains 2 Chill; a body shoved into it is Crushed, as against stone. A hard hit (yours or theirs) shatters it early: 40 and a Chill to everyone within 2.5 m. Two at a time.

fracture.name: Fracture
fracture.summary: One enemy in reach: a hammer blow, 2.0x strike damage and 60 poise. If it is Frozen or Brittle it Shatters for +120 more, and the shards fly 4 m instead of 2.5.

craze.name: Craze
craze.summary: Point, 9 m: fine cracks race through a 3 m circle for half a second, then everything in it is Brittle for 5 s: its next hard hit Shatters it, frozen or not. The way to break what will not freeze.

ice_shell.name: Ice Shell
ice_shell.summary: A shell of ice closes over you for 8 s: a 60 Ward (the shared cap). When it is broken it bursts: 40 damage and 2 Chill to everything within 2.5 m.

dead_calm.name: Dead Calm
dead_calm.summary: One enemy within 10 m goes utterly still for 2.5 s: it cannot move or act, whatever it was winding up is lost, and every status on it stops running down. It gains 2 Chill, and when the calm breaks it is Stilled - the next shove or drag on it goes twice as far. Heavy enemies hold half as long; an elite is only Stilled.

floe_drive.name: Floe Drive
floe_drive.summary: A sheet of ice 3 m wide slides out 9 m along the floor: everything it meets takes 30 and 2 Chill and is shoved 3 m along with it. A body it drives into a wall, stone or another body is Crushed, as water's are.

blot.name: Blot
blot.summary: A blot of darkness, thrown: 60 damage, and where it lands the ground goes Dark in a circle 2.5 m across for 6 s. Hit them again while they stand in it.

daybreak.name: Daybreak
daybreak.summary: Every pool of your darkness within 12 m lifts at once. Each enemy standing in one is caught in the sudden light: Dazed for 1.5 s and Exposed for 4 s. You lose the dark you made.

pall.name: Pall
pall.summary: Darkness pours out of you: a pall 3.5 m across at your feet for 6 s. Every enemy that had you in its sights loses you at once and goes to where it last saw you. Nothing sees into it or through it, those inside are Blinded, and you are Unseen in it - so your first hit out is an Ambush.

silhouette.name: Silhouette
silhouette.summary: One enemy within 12 m is outlined against the dark for 6 s: every hit on it counts as from behind (+30%, and a raised shield does not help). If it stands in Dark it is Blinded as well.

shadow_slip.name: Shadow Slip
shadow_slip.summary: Sink into the dark and rise from another shadow up to 10 m away: a Dark spot, or the shadow behind an enemy, which puts you at its back. Your first hit within 1 s counts as from behind. It cannot take you into the light.

shadownail.name: Shadownail
shadownail.summary: Point, 9 m: a black nail is driven into the shadows in a circle 1.5 m across. Whatever stands there after a quarter second takes 50 and is Shadowbound for 2.5 s (4 s in Dark): rooted where it stands, though it can still turn and swing.

muffle.name: Muffle
muffle.summary: For 6 s you make no sound. Striking no longer reveals you while you are Unseen, so every hit can be an Ambush; an enemy you hit that was not facing you takes +50%; and anything you kill raises no alarm - no call for help, and nobody within 10 m wakes.

stray_echo.name: Stray Echo
stray_echo.summary: Throw a sound into the dark - a footstep, a dropped blade - at a spot up to 14 m away. For 3 s every enemy within 8 m of it that is not in melee with you turns to face it and goes to look, its back to you. Anything within 1.5 m of the spot is interrupted. It is heard, not seen: it needs no sight line.

hungry_dark.name: Hungry Dark
hungry_dark.summary: One enemy in reach: the dark bites. 2.2x strike damage (more from behind, and an Ambush out of Unseen), and it swallows 1 light. If the bite leaves it under 20% health it is swallowed whole: it dies, you get 4 essence back and a second light, and the dark closes over you - Unseen for 1.5 s wherever you stand. The ground under it goes Dark for 4 s.

night_spill.name: Night Spill
night_spill.summary: Let out what the dark swallowed in a narrow gout 6 m long: 30, plus 35 for each light swallowed, to everything in it. At 3 or more they are Dazed; one left under 15% health is finished. The ground it covers goes Dark for 5 s.

spot_weld.name: Weld Line
spot_weld.summary: A line of molten iron thrown at one enemy, 9 m: 30 damage, it is dragged 3 m toward you, and for 5 s it is welded to you and Taunted - it fights you, and if you walk away it comes along, out of its pack.

splitting_blow.name: Splitting Blow
splitting_blow.summary: One enemy in reach: a cleaving blow, 2.4x strike damage and 60 poise. If it wears metal, its armour splits open and the pieces fly on behind it: 30 per metal class to everyone within 2.5 m.

breakthrough.name: Breakthrough
breakthrough.summary: Drive forward 5 m, point first. A bare enemy in the way stops you and is knocked back 1.5 m. One that wears metal is punched through: 40 damage, you carry on past it, and it is Stripped for 4 s.

red_iron.name: Red Iron
red_iron.summary: You draw the iron red-hot: your Edge Heat is full on the next enemy you strike, everything within 2 m takes 20 as the heat comes off you, and for 6 s every bare strike you land sets its target Alight.

whetted_cut.name: Whetted Cut
whetted_cut.summary: Hold to draw your weapon's edge keen, up to 1.5 s, walking at 45%. Let go for one cut across 60 degrees and 3.3 m: 1.6x strike damage at a tap, up to 3.2x at a full hold - and it spends your Edge Heat for +0.3x a stack.

turn_the_edge.name: Turn the Edge
turn_the_edge.summary: A 0.5 s guard, Braced. The first blow aimed at you from within 2.5 m is taken on your blade and does nothing: the attacker is Dulled for 6 s, Staggered (your next strike on it is an Opening), and becomes your Edge Heat target with 2 stacks. The ringing Dulls anyone else within 2 m. If nothing comes, half the essence comes back.

plating.name: Plating
plating.summary: For 8 s the metal you wear thickens: every blow on you does 30% less, and a blade that lands on you from within 2.5 m is Dulled for 3 s. You move at full speed.

wrench.name: Wrench
wrench.summary: One enemy in reach: you get a grip on its armour and wrench it off. 1.6x strike damage, interrupted, and Stripped for 8 s: no front armour, and it takes 20% more from everything. It no longer counts as armoured, so metal loses its own bonus on it.

iron_slug.name: Iron Slug
iron_slug.summary: You hammer a slug out of the iron you carry and hurl it: 70 damage and 35 poise. Like every metal hit it ignores a raised shield and hits plate hardest: 105 on a plated enemy.

iron_clasp.name: Iron Clasp
iron_clasp.summary: One enemy within 9 m: a band of iron snaps shut round its arms. 25 damage, interrupted, and Shackled for 2.5 s: it can still walk, but cannot attack. Each metal class it wears adds 1 s.

rust_bloom.name: Rust Bloom
rust_bloom.summary: Point, 9 m: rust blooms over a circle 3.5 m across for 7 s. Anything inside that wears metal is Rusting: 6 damage a second per metal class, and its front armour is halved. Bare skin does not care.

red_lancet.name: Red Lancet
red_lancet.summary: A thin blade of essence thrown along your aim. The first enemy it hits takes 50 and starts Bleeding (2 stacks).

tourniquet.name: Tourniquet
tourniquet.summary: For 6 s no blow opens a wound on you: each one that would have spends 2 blood instead - from a pool within 3 m of you first, then from what you hold. The blow still takes health from the bar; with no blood to spend, the wound opens as usual.

deep_draught.name: Deep Draught
deep_draught.summary: Drink it in at once, without stopping: one Bleeding stack is drawn out of every bleeding enemy within 6 m (12 damage each) and every blood pool within 4 m is drunk. Each stack or pool becomes 1 held blood (up to 6 from one cast).

outpour.name: Outpour
outpour.summary: Pour every measure of held blood out in a cone 6 m long: 30 damage plus 18 for each measure spent (210 with all ten), 1 Bleeding, and the floor where it lands runs with fresh pools.

clotblade.name: Clotblade
clotblade.summary: A wide sweep as cleavers of hardened blood form in your hands: 1.8x strike damage in front of you, and every Bleeding stack on a target sets hard in the cut for +22 damage and +12 poise (those stacks are spent). Then you keep the clotblades for 8 s - 1 s more for each held blood you spend, up to 4: your strikes do 1.5x and half again the poise damage, and each strike opens 1 Bleeding.

thinblood_rush.name: Thinblood Rush
thinblood_rush.summary: A fast 4.8 m dash that slips between bodies, cutting each one you pass for 15 and 1 Bleeding. Every blood pool you cross carries you 1.5 m further (up to +3 m), and you move 20% faster for 2 s after.

red_frenzy.name: Red Frenzy
red_frenzy.summary: Your heart pounds: for 8 s you strike 25% faster, move 25% faster, hit 20% harder and reach 0.4 m further, and light blows cannot stagger you. Every kill gives you 2 held blood. The first 3 s are free; after that it burns 1 held blood every 2 s, and it ends early when you run dry - never on your health.

heavy_heart.name: Heavy Heart
heavy_heart.simplified: blood pools in the circle do not go still
heavy_heart.summary: Point, 9 m: a 3 m circle for 6 s where hearts slow. Enemies in it are Sluggish (30% slower, wind-ups half again as long, bleeding slower) and take 8 a second. Every blood pool the circle touches goes still too and does the same for its 6 s. (simplified)

gullet_knot.name: Gullet Knot
gullet_knot.summary: One enemy within 10 m: its own blood knots in its throat. 30 damage and interrupted. If it is Bleeding it is Choked for 2.5 s (1 s if not): it cannot attack, shoot, cast or call for help, and walks at half speed.

long_breath.name: Long Breath
long_breath.summary: Breathe out up to 4 blood - pools within 3 m first, then what you hold: each takes 6 off your hottest reflux at once. Then for 6 s your poise is refilled and doubled, and reflux sheds twice as fast.

thirsting_glaive.name: Thirsting Glaive
thirsting_glaive.summary: Blood draws out into a long glaive in your hands for 10 s: your strikes reach 3.6 m in a 70 degree sweep at 1.3x, and each strike that lands on a bleeder draws 1 stack out of it into held blood. It swings faster the emptier you are: up to 30% faster with nothing held.

last_draught.name: Last Draught
last_draught.summary: One enemy in reach: 2.2x strike damage and +20 for each Bleeding stack on it (spent), 30% more if it is Dying. One left under 15% of its health dies outright if it was Bleeding (not elites). If it dies, its blood is yours: its stacks plus 3 as held blood.

knit.name: Knit
knit.summary: For 6 s you, and every living summon of yours within 6 m, regain 5 health a second - half as fast again for 2 s after each hit you land. It fills the bar up to the ceiling your wounds allow; once the bar is full, the rest seeps into your oldest wound at a quarter rate. A blow does not break it.

withering_needle.name: Withering Needle
withering_needle.summary: A needle of life turned inward. The first enemy hit takes 45 and 1 Withering (7 a second for 6 s, up to 3 stacks), past shields and armour. If it dies while Withering, its last life comes back to you: you regrow 10 health over 2 s.

fresh_stride.name: Fresh Stride
fresh_stride.summary: A 5.2 m dash on renewed legs. It never leaves you Winded and clears Winded if you are. For 3 s after you move 15% faster and regrow 3 health a second. It stops at bodies.

wearying_sweep.name: Wearying Sweep
wearying_sweep.summary: Everything within 3 m of you takes 1.7x strike damage and is Spent for 4 s (25% slower, attacks 30% slower). Every living enemy hit gives its stamina to you: 3 health over 3 s for each, up to 5.

corded_muscle.name: Corded Muscle
corded_muscle.summary: For 7 s your muscles thicken, and those of your living summons within 6 m: bare strikes do 40% more damage and 50% more poise damage, heavy blows take only half as much of your poise, and every point of health you regrow also refills a point of poise.

wasting_grip.name: Wasting Grip
wasting_grip.summary: One enemy in reach: a grip that wastes the body under it. 2.0x strike damage, and for 6 s it is Wasted: its blows do 30% less and its poise is cut to 60%. Open a Brute with it.

fever_break.name: Fever Break
fever_break.simplified: the player carries no enemy statuses yet: it clears stagger, Winded and a shove; 'heal_per_cleansed' is not built; 'heal_over_s' is not built; 'heal_cleansed_max' is not built
fever_break.summary: At once, ends every affliction of the body on you and your living summons within 6 m: burning, bleeding, poison, disease, withering, sickness and Winded. Each one ended lets the body mend: 4 health over 2 s (up to 4). For 5 s after, new afflictions last half as long. (simplified)

turn_the_stomach.name: Turn the Stomach
turn_the_stomach.summary: One living enemy within 9 m is Sick for 8 s: every 2.5 s it retches, loses whatever it was doing and stands still for half a second. 20 damage.

regrowth.name: Regrowth
regrowth.summary: Hold for up to 8 s, walking at 40%: 1.5 points a second go into your oldest wound until it closes and gives its share of the bar back, then into the next; a lost arm mends at half the rate. Living summons within 6 m regain 4.5 health a second. A blow no longer ends it: it stalls for 1 s and carries on.

unmending.name: Unmending
unmending.summary: Point, 9 m: after 0.4 s everything living within 3 m takes 30 and is Arrested for 8 s: it cannot heal or get its poise back, and the Life statuses on it stop running down. Cast it on the pack before the Censer-Bearer heals them.

lifeline.name: Lifeline
lifeline.summary: Hold on one living enemy within 8 m: a thread of its life runs into you. It takes 12 a second, past armour (a quarter more while it is Hale), and you regrow half of what it loses. You walk at 50%. The thread breaks if a wall comes between you or it gets 11 m away.

heartseed.name: Heartseed
heartseed.summary: You quicken a small living thing: a heartseed that floats at your shoulder for 15 s with 60 health. While it lives it pours 3 health a second into you and into your living summons within 6 m, and each hit you land makes it pulse 2 more into you. Enemies close by may strike it, and Life heals it. One at a time; it costs essence only, never your health.

endstroke.name: Endstroke
endstroke.summary: One enemy in reach: 2.0x strike damage, 30% more if it is Dying (below half). Anything short of an elite left under 15% of its health dies outright.

last_mercy.name: Last Mercy
last_mercy.summary: One enemy within 10 m is Spared for 4 s: nothing can take it below 1 health. If it is below half, it kneels and does nothing, and while it kneels your Death skills can take it as a corpse: Rise Again raises it on the spot.

rise_again.name: Rise Again
rise_again.summary: Point at a corpse within 10 m: it gets up and fights for you for 20 s, with 120 health, hitting the nearest enemy for 15 a blow. Up to three of your dead walk at once. Without a corpse nothing happens and nothing is spent.

lay_to_rest.name: Lay to Rest
lay_to_rest.summary: Every corpse within 6 m of you (up to 4) goes into the ground for good. Each gives you back 5 essence and takes 8 off your death reflux, and the ground drags down the enemies standing next to it: 40 poise damage and interrupted.

rotting_bolt.name: Rotting Bolt
rotting_bolt.summary: A clot of decay thrown along your aim: 50 and Rotting for 6 s (its armour and shield count for half, and lost poise does not come back). If it hits a corpse instead, the corpse bursts: 60 and Rotting to everything within 2.5 m.

embalm.name: Embalm
embalm.summary: For 8 s your thralls within 12 m are embalmed: they take 40% less damage and their time stops running down. Corpses near you stop decaying while it lasts.

lingering_shade.name: Lingering Shade
lingering_shade.summary: Point at a corpse within 10 m, or where something died in the last 10 s: its shade lingers there for 8 s in a 3 m circle. Enemies inside take 15 a second and are Dreading: they back out and will not walk in. The corpse is left for other uses.

banishing_line.name: Banishing Line
banishing_line.summary: An instant line 10 m long through everything: 55, 20 poise damage, and interrupts. Constructs, spirits and anything animated take triple.

gravestep.name: Gravestep
gravestep.summary: You pass out of sight and step out up to 6 m away, 12 m onto a corpse, or 14 m onto one of your thralls: you trade places with it, and it arrives with 40 health back. Every enemy that was aiming at you loses its aim.

death_mask.name: Death Mask
death_mask.summary: Point, 8 m: a likeness of you takes form out of grave-dust. For 5 s every enemy within 6 m turns on it instead of you. Raised on a corpse it is made of the body: it stands 8 s with twice the health, and the corpse is spent. When it breaks or its time runs out, it falls apart: 40 and Rotting to everything within 3 m.

grave_mark.name: Grave Mark
grave_mark.summary: One enemy within 12 m is marked for the grave for 6 s: every thrall of yours goes for it at once, hitting 50% harder and 30% faster, and it is Rotting while the mark lasts.

bone_burst.name: Bone Burst
bone_burst.summary: Let your dead go. Every thrall of yours within 12 m comes apart at once: 70, plus a quarter of the health it had left, to everything within 2.5 m of it, and Rotting. Nothing is left of them.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.summary: For 8 s you and every beast of yours within 8 m grow larger and stronger: 20% more damage, half the poise loss, and every blow you land regrows you 2 health.

dwindling_gall.name: Dwindling Gall
dwindling_gall.summary: A gall-vine takes root in one enemy within 9 m and shrinks it for 8 s: 20 damage, it counts one weight class lighter, and its reach is cut by 30%. When it dies, the gall falls and grows a bramble patch.

thornburst.name: Thornburst
thornburst.summary: Point, 9 m: after 0.35 s thorns burst up. 60 and Slowed to everything within 1.5 m, and the thorns stay as a bramble patch that spreads and thickens the longer it stands - ground you can stand in, and a beast you can call.

heartwood.name: Heartwood
heartwood.summary: Point, 8 m: a sapling bursts up into a trunk in 0.6 s, shoving anyone there aside for 25. For its first 6 s every enemy within 5 m turns on it instead of you. It blocks walking and shots for 30 s, toughens every second, and every 5 s spreads a bramble patch at its foot. One at a time.

sere_ground.name: Sere Ground
sere_ground.summary: Point, 10 m: every patch of your growth within 4 m dies at once, and everything standing in one takes 30 (45 if grown, 60 in bloom). The ground is clear again.

greening.name: Greening
greening.summary: Every patch of your growth within 12 m grows one age at once and puts out a new patch. For 6 s all of it works 50% harder, and you and your beasts In the Green regrow twice as fast and hit 15% harder.

heartrot.name: Heartrot
heartrot.summary: One enemy within 9 m, then two more within 5 m of each other: 40 each and Blighted for 8 s - their wooden shields and bows rot (shield half, aim slower) and Nature hits them 20% harder.

reaping_sweep.name: Reaping Sweep
reaping_sweep.summary: A wide scything sweep through 180 degrees: 1.8x strike damage. Each patch of your growth in the arc is cut back to a sprout and adds 15% to the blow (up to 60%), 1 essence and 3 health to you; the roots stay and regrow.

scatter_seed.name: Scatter Seed
scatter_seed.summary: Throw five seeds over a 2.5 m spread within 9 m. Each lies hidden until an enemy steps on it (or for 6 s), then bursts: 35 and Rooted for 1 s, and a snarevine patch that stays and spreads.

vine_reach.name: Vine Reach
vine_reach.summary: A vine lashes to a point within 9 m and hauls you there. Enemies within 1.5 m of where you land take 20 and are Rooted for 1 s, and a snarevine patch takes root on the spot, so you land In the Green.

unwinding.name: Unwinding
unwinding.summary: Every enemy your vines hold within 10 m is let go at once and whipped 3 m away from you for 40 (a Crush if it hits something). Anything holding you lets go too.

call_the_brake.name: Call the Brake
call_the_brake.summary: Point at a patch of your growth within 10 m: the thicket gives up a briar hound that runs with you for 20 s - 90 health, a bite of 12 every 0.9 s that Slows. A grown patch gives a hound a quarter stronger, a bloom patch two hounds half as strong again. The patch goes back to a sprout. Up to three hounds; with no patch in range nothing happens and nothing is spent.

unleash_the_pack.name: Unleash the Pack
unleash_the_pack.summary: Point at one enemy within 12 m: it becomes your Quarry (20 damage) and every beast of yours within 12 m leaps on it at once, each landing 30 poise damage. For 6 s they run wild: 40% more damage and 30% faster attacks. With no beasts out it only marks the Quarry.

dayline.name: Dayline
dayline.summary: An instant line of daylight, 16 m: the first thing on it takes 60 and is Lit for 6 s. Walls, stone and a raised shield stop it.

dusk_well.name: Dusk Well
dusk_well.summary: Point, 10 m: a pool of dusk 4 m across for 7 s. Nothing outside can see or shoot into it, and nothing inside can see out - but Lit enemies stay in plain view, and against the dusk they stand out: your light does 20% more to a Lit enemy inside it.

glint.name: Glint
glint.summary: You are a streak of light: up to 7 m along your aim in an instant, through enemies, searing each one you pass for 20 and lighting it. A wall, stone or a raised shield stops you short.

still_lamp.name: Still Lamp
still_lamp.summary: Point, 9 m: hang a steady lamp for 12 s. Every enemy within 5 m of it is Lit while it stays: it cannot hide and its armour's gaps show, and your Sears on anyone in its light are 10% heavier. One lamp at a time; it blocks nothing.

noonburst.name: Noonburst
noonburst.summary: Light and heat pour out of you: everything within 3.5 m with a clear line to you takes a heavy hit and is Lit. A raised shield shades whoever holds it.

gathered_light.name: Gathered Light
gathered_light.summary: Every Lit enemy within 12 m that has a clear line to you gives its light back: it takes 60 and loses Lit, and the ray coming home hits everything between it and you for 40.

hard_glare.name: Hard Glare
hard_glare.summary: A cone of hard light, 8 m long: everything in it takes 20 and is Blinded for 3 s. Archers lose their aim; others only swing at what is right in front of them.

clear_eye.name: Clear Eye
clear_eye.summary: For 6 s you see every gap: each enemy within 15 m is Lit at once, and your hits on Lit enemies ignore front armour completely.

glancing_ray.name: Glancing Ray
glancing_ray.simplified: it glances off walls and stone, not off raised shields
glancing_ray.summary: A ray that glances off walls, stone and raised shields up to twice, 14 m in all, hitting the first body on each leg for 55 and lighting it. Bank it off a wall to reach the back of a shield line. (simplified)

burning_glass.name: Burning Glass
burning_glass.summary: Bend the light through a lens onto one spot up to 14 m away: a bright point for 0.8 s, then it burns through - 130 to everything within 1.2 m, and 40 poise. Put it on a Lit enemy and the point follows it; anyone it burns that was Lit is Seared. Needs a clear line from you.

sunlance.name: Sunlance
sunlance.summary: Hold to draw the light into one line (up to 1.4 s, walking at 40%), then let it go: a lance of light 18 m long through every body on it, 90 to 280 by the charge, 50 poise, and Lit. Walls, stone and raised shields still stop it. Dear: the caster's big smite.

prism_bolt.name: Prism Bolt
prism_bolt.summary: A shard of light: 50 to the first enemy it hits, and there it breaks into four rays fanned 60 degrees on through it, 7 m each, 30 and Lit to the first body each finds. Into a crowd it lights the whole pack for the Sears that follow.

dozing_mote.name: Dozing Mote
dozing_mote.summary: A slow, drifting mote: 45, and the target nods. The first mote Dazes it; a second on a Dazed target puts it to sleep for 4 s. It must see the mote coming.

lucid.name: Lucid
lucid.summary: For 6 s you are wide awake while they dream: your Dream statuses last 30% longer and your casts recover 30% faster. Your phantoms and every mind you have turned within 12 m share it: they deal 30% more, and a phantom takes one more blow to break.

doubling_step.name: Doubling Step

leave_decoy.fools: enemies that see you as you cast

doubling_step.summary: Step 5 m aside and leave a phantom of yourself behind for 3 s. Enemies that were watching you go for the phantom instead; it breaks at the first blow.

shattered_dream.name: Shattered Dream
shattered_dream.summary: Every enemy within 10 m under one of your Dream spells wakes from it at once: 50 each, 100 to sleepers, and all of them are Dazed for 2 s. Your phantoms burst for 40.

night_terror.name: Night Terror
night_terror.summary: For a moment you are the thing under the bed: everything within 4 m that sees you takes a blow and is Terrified for 2 s - it turns, runs, and will not attack.

quiet_hour.name: Quiet Hour
quiet_hour.summary: Point, 9 m: a hush 3.5 m across for 7 s. Enemies in it that see it are Soothed: they move 30% slower and start no attacks. Hitting one snaps it out.

changeling_mask.name: Changeling Mask
changeling_mask.simplified: its friends attack the masked one, but it does not fight back
changeling_mask.summary: One enemy within 10 m that sees you wears your face for 4 s. Its friends within 8 m that see it take it for you and attack it, and it fights back. (simplified)

read_the_tell.name: Read the Tell
read_the_tell.summary: One enemy within 12 m that sees you shows its hand for 8 s: every attack it starts can be interrupted, and any hit during its wind-up staggers it. Works on elites.

errand.name: Errand
errand.summary: Point, 10 m: the enemy nearest that spot that can see you (or is asleep) walks to it and stands there 2 s without attacking - into your pool, out of the line, away from the Drummer. A hit breaks it.

shutter.name: Shutter
shutter.summary: Point, 10 m: minds within 3.5 m that see it close up: 25, and for 8 s they cannot be Drummed or Roused, and cannot call for help or answer a call.

sweet_lie.name: Sweet Lie
sweet_lie.summary: One enemy within 10 m that sees you believes, for 5 s, that it is on your side. It turns on the nearest of its friends, and they answer it. It counts as your summon (Lucid reaches it); hit it yourself and the lie ends. Heavy enemies believe half as long; an elite is only Dazed.

misgiving.name: Misgiving
misgiving.summary: A cone 7 m long of things half-seen: every enemy in it that sees you takes 15 and is Doubting for 6 s - its wind-ups take half again as long and its blows land 30% softer. Heavy enemies and elites doubt for half as long.

venom_edge.name: Venom Edge
venom_edge.summary: Wet the blade and cut across the front: 1.6x and 2 doses to everything in a 100-degree arc. The blade stays coated for 8 s or 8 hits: every weapon hit and ranged shot gives a dose.

black_purge.name: Black Purge
black_purge.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy weapon blow that drives every dose in it through at once - the whole bill now, at half again (30 a dose) - and interrupts. Your coat goes in after the purge, so the next bill starts at once.

fouling_slide.name: Fouling Slide
fouling_slide.summary: Slide 5 m straight through enemies with your blade out, fouling each one you brush: 2 doses each, and your coat as well.

clean_air.name: Clean Air
clean_air.summary: Point, 9 m: air 4 m across for 8 s that nothing foul can use. Enemies in it cannot be healed or Frenzied, a Censer-Bearer that dies inside bursts for nothing, and bills paid inside it are 20% larger.

caustic_spew.name: Caustic Sweep
caustic_spew.summary: Your weapon dripping with acid, a wide sweep in front of you, 3.1 m: a solid hit, a dose, and Corroded - each stack takes a third off their armour, shields included. It carries your coat.

counterdose.name: Counterdose
counterdose.summary: A shot of counter-agent from your ranged weapon (or thrown, without one): 45, and the target's doses are cancelled - no bill - while its body seizes for 0.3 s a dose (2.5 s at most), interrupting whatever it was doing.

sting_dart.name: Sting Dart
sting_dart.summary: A barbed dart from your ranged weapon (or thrown, without one): 50 and a dose, and the barb stays in - a dose every 1.5 s for 4.5 s more. The first dose starts the 6 s clock; when it runs out, every dose in the body is paid at once, 20 each.

funnel.name: Funnel
funnel.summary: One enemy within 10 m: every other dosed enemy within 6 m of it is flushed clean, and all their doses pour into it - up to 20. Its clock does not change.

sapping_tether.name: Sapping Tether
sapping_tether.summary: Hold on one enemy within 7 m: a thin thread drips a dose into it every half second, and while it holds the target deals 30% less damage and moves 30% slower. You walk at half speed; the thread breaks past 9 m or behind stone.

bitter_tonic.name: Bitter Tonic
bitter_tonic.summary: Drink it: for 8 s you move 15% faster, recover from skills a quarter sooner, your weapon hits 15% harder and your shots fly 15% further, and your coat is not worn off by hits (its time still runs).

steeped_blade.name: Steeped Blade
steeped_blade.summary: A slow thrust with a blade left to steep: one enemy in reach takes 1.8x and 2 doses and is Steeped - its clock runs 3 s longer and its bill pays 30 a dose instead of 20. The blade keeps the slow venom for 20 s or 15 hits: each one doses and Steeps.

venom_spur.name: Venom Spur
venom_spur.summary: Spur the venom on. Every Dosed enemy within 8 m has its clock cut to half a second: every bill comes due at once, at 80% (16 a dose). No blow, no line of sight needed.

fever_flask.name: Fever Flask
fever_flask.summary: Lob a flask up to 12 m: it bursts over shields and heads for 45 and 2 Infected, and leaves a sick cloud 2.5 m across that hangs 6 s and drifts slowly away from you.

crisis.name: Crisis
crisis.summary: Every Infected enemy within 10 m has its fever broken at once: 30 a stack, all now, and the stacks are gone. Armour still cuts it. A body broken at 5 stacks is Staggered as well.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.summary: One enemy within 9 m catches it (2 Infected); then every enemy within 3 m of it catches it, and every enemy within 3 m of those - up to 8 bodies, 20 and 1 Infected each. A Dying body passes 2 stacks instead of 1.

sealing_clot.name: Sealing Clot
sealing_clot.summary: A clot that sticks to one enemy: 45 and 3 Infected, and for 10 s the sickness is sealed in - it can climb to 10 stacks and burns half again as hard, but never leaves that body.

festering_hands.name: Festering Hands
festering_hands.summary: For 8 s every hit you land on an Infected enemy - bare strikes too - adds a stack, its poise stops refilling while the wound festers, and the nearest other enemy within 2 m catches a stack from it.

lancing_cut.name: Lancing Cut
lancing_cut.summary: One enemy in reach: a cut that lances its sickness - +25 a stack, the stacks drained - and what drains out hangs around it as a 2.5 m cloud for 5 s.

plaguebloom.name: Plaguebloom
plaguebloom.summary: A sick cloud heaves up out of the ground round you: everything within 3.5 m takes a blow, 25 poise damage and 1 Infected, and the cloud stays 6 s, drifting the way you face.

dispersal.name: Dispersal
dispersal.summary: Come apart into fog and gather again 5.5 m away, straight through enemies: each one you pass catches 1 Infected, and a little cloud hangs where you stood for 4 s.

teeming_fog.name: Teeming Fog
teeming_fog.summary: Point, 10 m: a thick fog 5 m across for 8 s, drifting slowly away from you. Flesh in it catches a stack every second, and anything that reaches 5 stacks inside it is overrun: its poise breaks once.

inured_blood.name: Inured Blood
inured_blood.summary: For 8 s you take 5% less damage for each Infected enemy within 8 m, up to 30%. Stand in the sick crowd you made.

plague_barrow.name: Plague Barrow
plague_barrow.summary: Point, 9 m, 0.4 s wind-up (Braced): grave-earth heaves up over a 2.5 m circle. Everything there takes 40, 2 Infected and is Mired. A barrow stays for 10 s: nothing walks through it (shots pass over), and every 2 s it breathes out a 2.5 m puff that gives 1 Infected.

exhume.name: Exhume
exhume.summary: Every corpse within 10 m, and every spot where an Infected enemy died in the last 15 s, bursts up out of the ground (up to 4): 50 and 2 Infected to everything within 2.5 m, and a cloud 2.5 m across that hangs 6 s. The corpses are spent.

dawnward.name: Dawnward
dawnward.summary: A ward of light closes round you for 8 s and takes the next 40 damage; each summon of yours within 6 m gets a 20 ward of its own. A ward a blow breaks bursts outward (30 and Lit, Holy's rule). Whatever is left of yours when the 8 s run out sinks in: half of it comes back to you as health, at once.

guardbreaker.name: Guardbreaker
guardbreaker.summary: One enemy in reach: 2.0x strike damage, and the proud are brought low. Its guard is broken (Exposed for 5 s: every hit counts as from behind and its shield does nothing) and every boon on it - Frenzied, Drummed, Roused - is stripped away. (simplified)

benediction.name: Benediction
benediction.summary: For 8 s you and your summons within 8 m are blessed: 20% more damage, half the poise loss, and every strike Lights what it hits (its armour counts half).

condemning_ray.name: Condemning Ray
condemning_ray.summary: An instant line of judging light, 14 m: the first thing on it takes 50 and is Condemned for 8 s - Lit, and every hit you or your summons land on it adds 4 to your ward (up to 30 from one Condemned foe). Walls, stone and a raised shield stop it.

absolution.name: Absolution
absolution.simplified: 'ward_per_cleansed' is not built; 'ward_cleansed_max' is not built
absolution.summary: At once, every bind on you and your summons within 8 m is lifted: stagger, holds, slows, stuns, blinding, choking and fear. You gain a 10 ward, and 8 more for each bind lifted (up to 40). For 4 s after, the next bind to reach you is turned away. (simplified)

penitent_mark.name: Penitent Mark
penitent_mark.summary: One enemy within 10 m must do penance for 8 s: 15 damage, and every attack it starts burns it for 25 (through you), and its blows on you and yours do 30% less. Lay it on the brute before it swings.

hallowed_ground.name: Hallowed Ground
hallowed_ground.summary: Point, 8 m: a 3.5 m circle is hallowed for 8 s. You and your summons inside take 20% less and gain 5 ward a second (up to 30). Enemies inside are Lit. Stand your ground in it. (simplified)

casting_out.name: Casting Out
casting_out.summary: A wall of light thrust out ahead: everything in a 90 degree cone 4 m deep takes 30, is shoved 3 m away and is Exiled for 4 s: it will not come within 4 m of you (archers still shoot).

kind_light.name: Kind Light
kind_light.summary: For 6 s a gentle light holds you and your summons within 6 m: every blow is 30% softer, and the light keeps what it softened. When it ends, 60% of that comes back to you as health, all at once. (simplified)

rebuke.name: Rebuke
rebuke.summary: Light breaks out of you in wrath: everything within 3 m with a clear line to you takes 1.7x strike damage and is Lit. If you are warded it strikes half again as hard, and spends no ward. (simplified)

zealous_charge.name: Zealous Charge
zealous_charge.summary: Charge 6 m behind a shield of light, Braced the whole way, stopping at the first body: it takes 1.5x strike damage and is interrupted. You arrive with a 15 ward. (simplified)

abiding_guard.name: Abiding Guard
abiding_guard.summary: Stand and wait for up to 1 s behind a guard of light. The first blow that lands in that time is stopped whole and answered: if its thrower is within 6 m it takes 2.5x strike damage, is Lit and Staggered, and you gain a 20 ward. If nothing comes, you keep a 10 ward for your patience.

reaving_cleave.name: Reaving Cleave
reaving_cleave.summary: A wide, heavy cleave in front of you (150 degrees): 1.8x, and it drains - a fifth of the damage it deals comes back to you as health (twice that from the Dying or from anything standing in Dark), up to 20 a swing.

black_reckoning.name: Black Reckoning
black_reckoning.summary: Let out everything you took. A cone of black 5 m long: 30, plus all your stolen life, to everything in it, and they lose that much poise too (up to 60). Your stolen life is spent. (simplified)

dreadcry.name: Dreadcry
dreadcry.summary: A cry that carries the dark in it. Everything within 4.5 m takes 25 and is Terrified for 2 s - it turns and runs from you, and cannot attack (heavy enemies 1 s, elites only Dazed). In Dark it runs for 3 s.

grasping_dark.name: Grasping Dark
grasping_dark.summary: One enemy within 12 m: a hand of shadow takes it and hauls it to arm's length in front of you: 45, it drains, and it is Leashed to you for 4 s - it cannot get more than 4 m from you.

gloom_mantle.name: Gloom Mantle
gloom_mantle.summary: For 8 s the dark hangs round you, 3.5 m across, and goes where you go. The ground in it counts as Dark, and every enemy in it loses 10 a second - drained to you, like every Unholy hit, and doubled because they stand in Dark.

black_shroud.name: Black Shroud
black_shroud.summary: Draw the dark tight round you: a ward of 40, plus all your stolen life (100 at most), that takes blows before your health does, for 8 s. While it holds nothing staggers you. If it breaks, the dark bursts off you: everything within 3 m is Terrified for 1.5 s.

reaping_blow.name: Reaping Blow
reaping_blow.summary: One enemy in reach: a slow, heavy blow, 2.4x, that drains 30% of what it deals (60% from the Dying), up to 30. If it kills, all the health it had left before the blow is stolen.

torment.name: Torment
torment.summary: One enemy within 10 m: 20, and it is Tormented for 8 s - it loses 8 a second, half of which comes to you as health, and its poise does not refill. Nothing spreads; it is one body's slow ending.

night_charge.name: Night Charge
night_charge.summary: Charge 6.7 m along your aim through the dark and stop on the first enemy you reach: 1.4x, it drains, and it is Leashed to you for 2 s. The ground you crossed stays Dark for 5 s.

forsaken_ground.name: Forsaken Ground
forsaken_ground.summary: Break off: leap 5 m back, away from your aim, and leave the ground you stood on forsaken - a Dark circle 3 m across for 4 s. Enemies in it take 10 a second and are Dreading: they back out and will not walk in.
